claim: The demo CLEAN_ROOM_START regex is anchored with ^ and $ under re.M so it only matches a line consisting solely of BẮT ĐẦU or APPROVE with optional punctuation.
The demo contaminated_clean_room_reads skips tool calls not in READ_TOOLS and skips empty forbidden entries, returning a list without duplicates.
The demo READ_TOOLS mapping includes run_command mapped to CommandLine and read_url_content mapped to Url.
The demo READ_TOOLS mapping omits run_command.
The demo CLEAN_ROOM_START regex has no anchors and matches BẮT ĐẦU anywhere in a sentence.
The demo contaminated_clean_room_reads normalizes backslashes to forward slashes before matching.
